<script>
  import { setCurrency } from './currency.js';
  import Header from './Header.svelte';
  import ProductList from './ProductList.svelte';
  import Cart from './Cart.svelte';
  import Modal from './Modal.svelte';
  import CheckoutForm from './CheckoutForm.svelte';

  let { products } = $props();

  setCurrency('USD');

  let checkoutOpen = $state(false);
</script>

<Header oncheckout={() => (checkoutOpen = true)} />
<ProductList {products} />
<Cart />

{#if checkoutOpen}
  <Modal onclose={() => (checkoutOpen = false)}>
    <CheckoutForm oncomplete={() => (checkoutOpen = false)} />
  </Modal>
{/if}

<script>
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';

  let { onsearch, delay = 300 } = $props();

  let value = $state('');
  let timer;

  function handleInput() {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => onsearch(value), delay);
  }

  onDestroy(() => clearTimeout(timer));
</script>

<input type="search" placeholder="Search products" bind:value oninput={handleInput} />
